instruction: A candid documentary photograph, medium shot from a low angle, inside a judo dojo with yellow and blue mats. On the left, the young woman in the blue judogi (R1) kneels on the mat, looking down. Beside her in the center, the young man in the white judogi (R2) also kneels, looking forward. In the foreground right, the older man in the white judogi (R3) is positioned with his back to the camera, squatting as he faces the two students. The scene is illuminated by bright, natural indoor lighting, casting soft shadows on the beige wall behind them.
elements: R3 squats with his back to the camera while facing R1 and R2
R1 kneels looking down while R2 kneels looking forward
R1 and R2 are the two kneeling students being faced by R3

judo dojo setting with a beige wall
